card.title: I Was There
card.instruction: Treat your presence during a difficult time as an enduring claim on loyalty, honesty, and consideration.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I stayed all night when your business failed. Are you borrowing against the house again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a small loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At four in the morning, 'small' meant your entire savings. I deserve the figure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll show you the application. You don't get a veto.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me before you sign. That night earned me a conversation while there's still a choice.
